content:
🧪  `heze-devnet@v2.0.0`: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests-heze-devnet@v2.0.0

First release for `heze-devnet-2` (the renamed FOCIL devnets), **on the EL side** from [`devnets/heze/2`](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/tree/devnets/heze/2). Details in the [release tracker](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/issues/3783).
- EIP-8198: base fee max change `5/48`; blobs 12/18, update fraction 12018519.
- EIP-7805: the IL check skips blob transactions; raw-bytes IL entries and much wider appendability coverage.

Thanks <@486501030046203915>, <@348512261955911691>, <@755913785620824175>, and <@892053833121923094>
